title_sq: Shitet, Ambient Biznesi, Kompleksi Green City – Astir, 170,000 Euro
description_sq:
Karakteristika te prones:
– Ambient biznesi
– Rruga Nexho Konomi
– Zona Astir/ Kompleksi Green City
– Ndertim i ri
– Kati 0
– Bosh
– Fasade xhami
– Siperfaqja 45m²
– Cmimi 170,000 Euro
Shitet ambient biznesi, me siperfaqe 45m², i pozicionuar ne katin 0 te nje pallati te ri me ahsensor, brenda kompleksit Green City, Astir.
Ambienti perbehet nga disa shkalle ne hyrje, qe te lidhin me hapesiren open space me 3 vetrata te medha xhami. Disponon nje tualet te kompletuar me hidrosanitaret dhe lavamanin.
Disponon certefikate pronesie. Shitet dhe me financim kredie.
Hapësira e jashtme e kompleksit përbëhet nga lulishte me 2 pishina private si dhe kënde lojërash dhe parkingje apo garazhe private. Ambienti mund te perdoret per zyra, klinika, qender estetike, dyqan etj.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Business Area, Green City Complex - Astir, 170,000 Euros
description_en: Property characteristics: - Business environment - Nexho Konomi Street - Astir area/ Green City Complex - New building - Floor 0 - Empty - Glass facade - Surface area 45m² - Price 170,000 Euros Business environment for sale, with an area of ​​45m², located on the 0th floor of a new building with an elevator, within the Green City complex, Astir. The environment consists of several stairs at the entrance, which connect to the open space with 3 large glass windows. It has a toilet complete with sanitary ware and a sink. It has ownership certificates. It is also sold with credit financing. The exterior space of the complex consists of flower gardens with 2 private swimming pools as well as playgrounds and private parking lots or garages. The environment can be used for offices, clinics, aesthetic centers, shops, etc. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
